title: 9 第九章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

都竞华只能庆幸眼前的副本是单人副本，不会有同伴目睹到自己推测错误的一幕。

恢复平静后，都竞华面无表情地将道具放回背包中，准备等回村后就让指南针回到它该去的地方，比如路边的商店或者垃圾桶。

后厨中传来烤面包的香气，休息够的铁匠再次了，可对庆典的期待还是让村民们振作起了精神。

都竞华放缓了脚步，她抬起头，望向村庄中心的方向。

村庄的介绍中提到过，为了庆祝庆典，需要村民于夜晚时分在广场上进行献祭，献祭的内容可以是战斗的证明或者丰饶的证明，也可以两者兼有，随后就能获得赐福。

对村民而言，庆典是真实的，获得的赐福也是真实的。

合理的仪式能够拥有魔力。

都竞华目标明确地走到日晷旁，小心地放下了自己打到的狼牙跟新鲜出炉的面包，还调整了下物品位置，好让画面看着更加和谐。

路过的村民好奇：“庆典还没开始呢，你摆放祭品做什么？”

都竞华：“庆典真的还没开始吗？”

村民：“？？？”

对方的脸上写满了真实的茫然。

都竞华：“也许已经开始，只是无人察觉。”

或许是她的错觉，话音落下的瞬间，周围的时间似乎有短暂的凝滞。

“滴答。”

仿佛有指针走动的声音在空中响起。

村民：“已经……开始了吗？”

都竞华道：“起码是一个合理的排查方向。”

当然都竞华之所以做出如上猜测，除了她脑洞比较大，加上单人副本缺乏围观群众即使猜错也不会成为黑历史，更是因为在做任务的路上，都竞华发现村庄中的NPC里面打瞌睡的打瞌睡，哈欠连天的哈欠连天，连铁匠铺这种核心商业地点都会因为老板支撑不住而暂时闭店。

种种细节都显示，村民们整体处于一个过劳的状态当中。

期末总是一手冰美式一手论文的都竞华只觉眼前的画面很有既视感，让她想起了为绩点熬夜奋战的日日夜夜。

都竞华最开始更多是以为村民们如此疲惫，是因为在为了庆典做准备，可在村庄里跑了几圈后又不确定了，因为她觉得主要的苦活累活主要都是她在干……

游戏时常会在某些细节上给玩家留下提示，都竞华既然觉得村民们的模样很像是在熬夜，再结合上今天的天气，加上广场中央无法起到作用的日晷，一个念头就自都竞华心头浮现。

——或许现在根本就不是白天，而是早已到了晚上。

庆典应该开始了。

此时此刻，虽然苍穹依旧明亮，可身周的凉意却异常明显，都竞华从未忘记《失落大陆》是一个拥有魔法的世界，大晚上让天空亮如白昼并非不可能出现的事情。

或许是为了回应都竞华的猜测，一阵风吹起，吹开了天上厚密的云层。

都竞华仰首望去，看见天上正悬挂着一颗“太阳”，但只要仔细观察片刻，就会发现那颗“太阳”虽然发着光芒，却并不刺眼，形状也更加类似于心脏，只是外形不够规则。

“太阳”甚至还给人一种正在跳动的错觉。

魔法，都是魔法。

都竞华在心里淡定地感慨了两句副本的背景设定。

围观的村民们窃窃私语一阵后，广场附近的屋子里走出了一个头发花白的老婆婆。

老婆婆手中拄着一根比成人还高的奇异拐杖，杖身上布满了复杂的符文，上面还点缀着各类漂亮的羽毛与宝石，从外形上就能看出必然是关键NPC。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Du Jinghua could only be thankful that the dungeon in front of him was a single-player dungeon, and no companions would witness his wrong guess.

After regaining his composure, Du Jinghua expressionlessly put the props back into his backpack, preparing to return the compass to where it should go, such as a roadside shop or a trash can, after returning to the village.

The aroma of baking bread came from the kitchen, and the blacksmith had rested enough. However, the anticipation of the celebration still cheered up the villagers.

Du Jinghua slowed down her pace, raised her head, and looked towards the center of the village.

The introduction of the village mentioned that in order to celebrate the celebration, villagers need to make sacrifices in the square at night. The content of the sacrifice can be proof of battle, proof of fertility, or both, and then they can receive blessings.

For the villagers, the celebration is real and the blessings received are also real.

Proper rituals can have magic power.

Du Jinghua walked to the sundial with a clear goal, carefully put down the wolf teeth and freshly baked bread that he had beaten, and also adjusted the positions of the items to make the picture look more harmonious.

Villagers passing by were curious: "The celebration hasn't started yet. Why are you placing the sacrifices?"

Du Jinghua: "Has the celebration really not started yet?"

Villager: "???"

The other person's face was filled with real confusion.

Du Jinghua: "Maybe it has already started, but no one noticed it."

Perhaps it was her imagination, but the moment the words fell, the time around her seemed to freeze briefly.

"Tick tock."

The sound of moving hands sounded in the air.

Villager: "Has it... started yet?"

Du Jinghua said: "At least it is a reasonable investigation direction."

Of course, the reason why Du Jinghua made the above guess was not only because of her large imagination, but also the lack of onlookers in the single-player dungeon. Even if she guessed wrong, it would not become a black history, but also because on the way to do the task, Du Jinghua found that the NPCs in the village were dozing off and yawning all day long. Even core business locations such as blacksmith shops were temporarily closed because the boss could not support them.

Various details show that the villagers are in a state of overwork as a whole.

Du Jinghua, who always writes American-style essays at the end of the semester, felt that the picture in front of her had a sense of familiarity, reminding her of the days and nights when she stayed up late and worked hard for her grades.

Du Jinghua initially thought that the villagers were so tired because they were preparing for the celebration, but after running around the village for a few times, she was not sure because she felt that she was mainly doing the hard work...

The game often leaves hints to players on certain details. Since Du Jinghua felt that the villagers looked like they were staying up late, combined with today's weather and the inoperable sundial in the center of the square, an idea emerged in Du Jinghua's mind.

——Perhaps it is not daytime at all, but already night.

The celebration should begin.

At this moment, although the sky is still bright, the coolness around him is extremely obvious. Du Jinghua has never forgotten that "Lost Continent" is a world with magic. It is not impossible for the sky to be as bright as day at night.

Perhaps in response to Du Jinghua's speculation, a gust of wind blew away the thick clouds in the sky.

Du Jinghua looked up and saw a "sun" hanging in the sky. But if you look carefully for a moment, you will find that although the "sun" is shining, it is not dazzling, and its shape is more similar to a heart, but its shape is not regular enough.

The "sun" even gives the illusion of beating.

Magic, it's all magic.

Du Jinghua calmly lamented the background settings of the two copies in his heart.

After the onlookers whispered for a while, an old woman with gray hair walked out of a house near the square.

The old woman is holding a strange crutch that is taller than an adult. The stick is covered with complex runes and dotted with various beautiful feathers and gems. From its appearance, it can be seen that it must be a key NPC.
